metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the third act begun, the reckoning, the call, and the memo.

yesterday: Eight-and-twenty shillings. Last Saturday was four-and-thirty. The house stands. That was the news in the room.
Cuthbert, from Holywell. Allen rode in from Essex. Two years less a month. Four-and-twenty pound a year, where they pay fourteen. A clause about the house after five years. He did not explain it.
Nothing to a landlord. To his father, a year. You will tell James you have a king coming, and that it is long. Nothing is agreed.
You did not write Sunday's letter.
